why_canonical: Small enough for source validators and unit tests.
Covers map cells, terrain height, building plug, road plug, connector path segment, connector asset reference, connector manifest reference, and placement policy reference.
References an existing source connector asset ID from connector_asset_manifest_v0.json.
Uses deterministic IDs and explicit no-claims.
Contains no render, media, mesh, screenshot, Blender, or generated proof output fields.
